title: Esses channel mappings (mappings-1)
description: <Project>/channels/mappings.json (02 sections 4.6 and 6.3, D-013): logged name -> analysis name renames, matched case-insensitively (each logged name at most once, checked by the loader), optionally stamping a unit (unitlessOnly: only on a channel without one). Unknown top-level members are allowed and preserved; mapping records are closed.

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

unitSymbol.description: A unit symbol or alias of the unit registry (units-1), without leading or trailing white space.

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
